items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: when, when, when we left, left Chicago and, and joined, uh, uh, Jack Tilson with, with his band

ctx.x: Oh, we were talking about Jeanette. Oh, Jeanette.

All right. So, so I, I have to think about this, this pianist, see. Well, anyway, when, when, when we left, left Chicago and, and joined, uh, uh, Jack Tilson with, with his band, see. We had these four men, and then we got other guys like Skinny Budd playing tennis saxophone. He used some tarryhaw and played good. He liked the way, the way, uh, oh, what's his name? He played, uh, saxophone. Don, not Don Martin. Don Martin played clarinet with Whiteman's band and Goldkiss band. But saxophone, you know, great…
Well, so many of them. Jack Pettis, uh, Trombone.
